errors: SLA_CATALOG_NOT_FOUND
Requested Product Line/Contract/CPL/policy/classification target does not exist.
SLA_CATALOG_ARCHIVED
Requested catalog target is not eligible for the new active operation.
SLA_CONTRACT_CUSTOMER_IMMUTABLE
Ordinary edit cannot transfer a Contract to another Customer Organization.
SLA_CPL_POLICY_MISSING
Contract Product Line has no current accepted SLA policy and is not eligible for active classification.
SLA_POLICY_INVALID
Policy percentages/durations/severity structure or derived Non-fault tiers violate POLICY_VALIDATION_V1.
SLA_POLICY_STALE
Contract Product Line/current-policy revision changed since preview.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_CUSTOMER_UNRESOLVED
Service Request Customer Organization is unresolved; no CPL may be fabricated.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_CROSS_CUSTOMER
Target Contract Product Line belongs to a different Customer Organization.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_MAPPING_MISSING
No active trusted classification mapping applies.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_MAPPING_AMBIGUOUS
More than one active trusted mapping applies; operator review is required.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_STALE
Service Request Customer/source/CPL/policy/classification state changed since preview.
SLA_CLASSIFICATION_INCOMPATIBLE
Target CPL is inactive, policyless or otherwise incompatible with current SR Customer state.
SLA_INPUT_INDETERMINATE
Accepted SR/source/customer input required for authoritative SLA evaluation could not be determined safely.
SLA_REPORT_SCOPE_INVALID
Report period, timezone-derived boundary, Customer scope or destination request is invalid.
SLA_REPORT_ATTEMPT_STATE
Report attempt is not in the required state for this transition.
SLA_REPORT_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH
Persisted staged count/hash/section result does not match the exact snapshot generation.
SLA_REPORT_CONTRIBUTOR_FAILED
A required report section contributor failed or returned indeterminate/incomplete output.
SLA_REPORT_ARTIFACT_WRITE_FAILED
XLSX artifact could not be produced completely.
SLA_REPORT_ARTIFACT_VERIFY_FAILED
Generated artifact failed reopen/shape/count/hash verification and cannot become completed evidence.
SLA_REPORT_COMPLETED_IMMUTABLE
Completed report evidence cannot be updated, cancelled, minimized or cleaned by this operation.
SLA_REPORT_CANCEL_UNSAFE
Report job cannot be cancelled at the requested instant; cancellation waits for the next safe boundary.
SLA_DEPENDENCY_INDETERMINATE
Cross-domain lifecycle/classification/report dependency could not be classified safely; mutation is blocked.
SLA_STALE
A required revision or exact input fingerprint changed; refresh and review again.
rule: Missing chronology/classification and live compliance states are truthful domain projection states, not transport failures. Errors are reserved for invalid commands, unsafe ambiguity, stale authority, persistence/job/artifact failures or indeterminate dependencies.
